subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should the remaining Google Chat Space failure be fixed narrowly in mention detection, or explicitly consolidated into broader Google Chat Space routing work?
rationale: The classifier half is already fixed, but the remaining failure crosses Google Chat annotation parsing, `botUser` expectations, diagnostics, and adjacent Space/thread routing work, so maintainers should choose the product boundary before automation writes a patch.

options.title: Fix mention gate narrowly
options.body: Preserve the current classifier and make current Google Chat @mention annotations, configured `botUser`, or safe BOT-user auto-detection satisfy `requireMention`, with live Space proof.

options.title: Consolidate into routing work
options.body: Move this remaining mention/session failure into the broader Google Chat Space routing item and close this only after that item explicitly owns the accepted-then-dropped case.

options.title: Document workaround only
options.body: Relying on per-space `requireMention:false` would keep users unblocked but leave the documented @mention Space behavior broken.

recommendation.title: Fix mention gate narrowly
recommendation.body: Preserve the current classifier and make current Google Chat @mention annotations, configured `botUser`, or safe BOT-user auto-detection satisfy `requireMention`, with live Space proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent modern Space classification coverage makes this the closest current maintainer-facing routing contact in the evidence set.
